chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُولَوَيْهَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashi: Muhammad ibn Qulawayh, from Sa'd ibn Abdallah, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid and Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ وَهُوَ يُحَدِّصُ أَصْحَابَهُ بِحَدِيثِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَبْإٍ وَمَا ادَّعَى مِنْ الرَّبُوبِيَّةِ فِي أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَقَالَ: إِنَّهُ لَمَّا ادَّعَى ذَلِكَ فِيهِ اسْتَتَابَهُ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَتُوبَ فَأَحْرَقَهُ بِالنَّارِ

translations.en: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say while relating to his companions the affair of Abdallah ibn Saba and his claim of divinity regarding the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him): He said: When he claimed that about him, the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) gave him a chance to repent, but he refused to repent, so he burnt him with fire.

en.summary: This narration from Rijal al-Kashi highlights the historical claim of divinity (Rabbubiyyah) by Abdallah ibn Saba regarding Imam Ali (peace be upon him). Upon hearing this claim, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) invited Ibn Saba to repent, but when he refused, he was executed by burning.
en.seo_question: What was the claim of Abdallah ibn Saba regarding Imam Ali and how did the Imam respond?

key_terms.عبد الله بن سبإ: Abdallah ibn Saba, a companion known for his claim of divinity regarding Ali
key_terms.الربوبية: Divinity or Lordship, the theological claim attributed to Ibn Saba
key_terms.أمير المؤمنين: Commander of the Faithful, a title for Imam Ali
key_terms.استتابه: He invited him to repent / He sought his repentance
key_terms.فأحرقه بالنار: So he burnt him with fire
